newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - June 19.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - June 19.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said it had two large one day net misses in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.

The first miss occured on Tuesday when there were fewer reserves in the banking system because Treasury deposits were much higher than anticipated, the spokeswoman said. The reverse was true for a miss on Tuesday, while float was also higher than anticipated then, she added.
The high in natural float was a bit under $5.5 billion on Tuesday, while the low in natural float was above $475 million on Friday.
Transportation float averaged about $75 million per day with the high on Tuesday at about $900 million primarily due to scattered weather delays in Texas, Oklahoma and Arkansas.
